shared_elements: carved relief on a rectangular/shaped stone panel
bird or bird-like imagery (eagle-headed creature in A; possible bird/winged emblem and feathered forms in B)
register-like framing with a border line at the top
justification: Both are low-relief carved panels dominated by profile imagery with fine incised linear detail, and both may involve avian/winged motifs, but that is about as far as the correspondence goes. A shows a single large-scale eagle-headed winged creature filling the whole field, while B shows a multi-figure scene of small standing/seated human figures with objects and sign-like symbols arranged in a compact group under an arched top; the scale, subject and composition are fundamentally different.
